description: This file contains legacy functions related to executing test cases within the TestLink open-source test management system. It includes functions for creating result menus, writing execution results to the database, managing bugs associated with executions, fetching execution data, deleting executions, updating notes, and handling attachments. It appears to serve as a collection of procedural functions rather than defining classes, primarily supporting the execution and bug-tracking workflows within the project.

methods.name: createResultsMenu
methods.description: Builds a dropdown menu structure for testing results based on configuration, allowing exclusion of certain status codes.

methods.name: write_execution
methods.description: Handles saving execution results, custom fields, attachments, and related bug tracking information into the database.

methods.name: write_execution_bug
methods.description: Deletes + inserts bug associations for a specific execution and test step to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: get_bugs_for_exec
methods.description: Retrieves bugs associated with a specific execution, including links and resolution status.

methods.name: get_execution
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific test execution, supports multiple output formats.

methods.name: delete_execution
methods.description: Deletes a test execution record and all related data, including attachments and steps.

methods.name: updateExecutionNotes
methods.description: Updates the notes/comments for a given execution record.

methods.name: getBugsForExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves bugs related to a set of executions, with bug details and links.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates an issue in external bug trackers and associates it with a test execution.

methods.name: copyIssues
methods.description: Duplicates bug associations from one execution to another.

methods.name: generateIssueText
methods.description: Generates descriptive text and report details to be used when creating issues.

methods.name: getIssueTrackerMetaData
methods.description: Fetches metadata (issue types, priorities, components, versions) from bug tracker integration.

methods.name: completeCreateIssue
methods.description: Fills in issue creation context with signature and metadata.

methods.name: completeIssueForStep
methods.description: Populates issue context with step-level data.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToExec
methods.description: Handles attachment uploads for execution and test steps.
